summary_1line: Hanuman searches Ravana’s lavish banqueting hall, realizes Mandodari is not Sita, reflects on dharma while observing sleeping women, and continues his search.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman leaps joyfully among the pillars of the palace hall, tail waving, believing he has found Sita sleeping on a jeweled bed.
The banqueting hall glitters with golden vessels, wine jars, scattered jewelry, and sleeping women resting among garlands and couches.
Hanuman stands thoughtfully among the sleeping women of Ravana’s palace, reflecting on dharma while searching their faces for Sita.
